purpose: Fail-closed inventory for preserving user value, execution truth, and security authority during the NovaForge 2.0 controlled generational rewrite.

stores.location: Application Support/NovaForge.store (+ SQLite -wal/-shm companions when present)

sourceEvidence.fact: LaunchPersistenceStorePaths names NovaForge.store as the primary durable SwiftData store and treats main/WAL/SHM as one recovery set.
Launch repair reads persisted settings, conversations, and project records before mutation; AgentSettingsRecordSelection establishes one canonical durable settings row.

requiredBeforeReplacement: Representative legacy-store migration fixtures pass without project, conversation, history, artifact, settings, or accepted-run loss.
The replacement store can be opened after relaunch and preserves stable record identity/lineage where identity is meaningful.
The old store remains recoverable until the replacement has a durable accepted commit marker.

sourceEvidence.fact: LaunchPersistenceContainerSelector keeps serving an active durable compatibility branch even when primary becomes readable, until explicit identity-aware reconciliation clears it.

requiredBeforeReplacement: Identity-aware reconciliation proves the compatibility branch contains no newer unique user state than the selected replacement.
The active compatibility guard is cleared durably only after reconciliation succeeds.

sourceEvidence.fact: LaunchPersistenceStoreQuarantine copies and fingerprints the exact SQLite main/WAL/SHM preimage, writes a durable manifest and verified commit, and deliberately leaves the source store intact.

requiredBeforeReplacement: A documented retention policy exists that never deletes the only verified recovery preimage for an unresolved migration.
Recovery manifest and verified-commit validation remain fail-closed.

sourceEvidence.fact: AgentEngineRunIndexStorePaths defines the protected process-safe v1 run ownership ledger under AgentEngine/v1 with strict containment, symlink rejection, complete data protection, and backup exclusion.

requiredBeforeReplacement: Accepted run ownership/recovery identity can be round-tripped into the new Mission Engine without duplicate execution.
Crash/relaunch recovery rejects stale or conflicting ownership after migration.
The replacement preserves evidence needed to distinguish accepted, interrupted, and terminal execution state.

sourceEvidence.fact: AgentPolicyStorePaths is the canonical protected composition boundary for policy-authority and mutation-effect-lifecycle ledgers and requires complete data protection plus backup exclusion.

requiredBeforeReplacement: A new policy authority proves equivalent or stronger approval binding and mutation replay protection before old ledgers are retired.
No model output or migrated record can mint authority that was not previously accepted.
Policy/checkpoint storage remains symlink-safe, contained, and fail-closed.

stores.location: Physical device: Data Protection Keychain service com.joey.NovaForge / account agent-policy.approval-ui-hmac.v1; Simulator-only fallback: Application Support/AgentPolicy/v1/simulator-approval-signing-key

sourceEvidence.fact: Physical devices persist the approval HMAC key as a non-synchronizable Data Protection Keychain generic-password item with when-unlocked-this-device-only accessibility; unsigned Simulator uses a protected AgentPolicy file only for simulator test authority.

requiredBeforeReplacement: Physical-device signing key material is never exported or plaintext-migrated; a replacement policy authority reads the existing Keychain account in place.
Missing or corrupt existing signing authority never causes silent replacement authority to be minted during migration.
Simulator-only key reset is permitted only together with the simulator/test policy authority it authenticates; simulator behavior is never evidence for physical-device key migration.

sourceEvidence.fact: POSIXWorkspaceCheckpointStore publishes immutable content-addressed whole-workspace before-state snapshots and exposes idempotent restore for interrupted mutation recovery.

requiredBeforeReplacement: Every accepted in-flight mutation that requires rollback retains a valid restore checkpoint or an equivalent verified replacement.
Checkpoint identity remains bound to workspace, revision, effect key, operation payload, and before-state digest.

stores.location: Resolved by AgentWorkspaceRootProviding; deliberately not coupled to the SwiftData database path.

sourceEvidence.fact: The debug persistence reset explicitly leaves user workspaces untouched while resetting engine/policy/SwiftData test authority.
Workspace mutation checkpoints resolve a workspace root through AgentWorkspaceRootProviding and verify root/containment identity before restore.

requiredBeforeReplacement: All project source/assets remain byte-equivalent unless an accepted migration explicitly transforms a format.
Workspace identity and project binding survive relaunch and migration.
No rewrite path treats missing workspace metadata as permission to delete filesystem content.

sourceEvidence.fact: KeychainStore saves generic-password credential data under service com.joey.NovaForge with kSecAttrAccessibleWhenUnlockedThisDeviceOnly.

requiredBeforeReplacement: Credential references may be remapped, but secret values are never serialized through SwiftData, JSON migration manifests, logs, History, Project Brain, or export packages.
A replacement credential API reads existing accounts in place or requires an explicit user re-authentication; migration never silently copies plaintext secrets.

rewriteRules: Presentation architecture, giant views, duplicated UI state, and legacy navigation may be replaced without preserving their internal shape.
Durable user value, accepted execution evidence, rollback checkpoints, policy authority, and credentials must not be deleted because a new module has been introduced.
A new architecture becomes authoritative only after an exact accepted migration/reconciliation checkpoint exists; creation of an empty replacement is never proof of migration.
Derived presentation caches and transcript projections may be rebuilt only from durable source truth; raw chat transcript is not promoted into the NovaForge 2.0 project database.
No migration may weaken path containment, symlink rejection, data protection, approval authority, replay protection, or evidence provenance.
